metadata.notes: Local-first Markdown knowledge workspace: Tauri 2 desktop shell, Rust vault/indexing kernel, React renderer, authenticated local daemon RPC (length-prefixed postcard frames over Windows named pipe / Unix socket, HMAC endpoint auth), two MCP servers, and permissioned external integrations (Google Calendar/Tasks, OpenAI-compatible AI provider, Ollama, Zotero, Pandoc/Tectonic/PlantUML/PDF-translator/code-runtime subprocesses). Node citations list concrete symbols; edge payload_type names real DTOs/envelopes; flow steps cite exact file:line locations.

nodes.name: React Renderer
nodes.description: Single-page React workspace (Vite + Tauri webview). Mounts the app, applies theme, installs E2E/screenshot bridges, and renders the shell, panels, knowledge workbench and command palette. All native work is invoked through the typed bridge layer.

nodes.name: Tauri Desktop Shell (native adapter + authorization broker)
nodes.description: Rust Tauri 2 host: registers ~170 invoke commands, owns AppState (vault session, watcher, export cancel slot, headless-engine flag, authorization broker), starts the daemon sidecar, registers tray/deep-link platform actions, and forwards daemon RPC events to the webview. Every sensitive native operation requires a one-time grant from the authorization broker.

nodes.name: Headless Daemon (local RPC server)
nodes.description: `scriptor-daemon serve`: authenticates local clients via HMAC endpoint file, serves length-prefixed postcard RPC frames over a Windows named pipe (`scriptor-core`) or Unix socket, enforces rate limits (60 RPC/s/connection, 32 concurrent connections), executes typed RpcMethods plus a JSON command catalog, and runs background index/export jobs.

ports: local socket 'scriptor-core' (Windows named pipe / Unix socket)

nodes.name: scriptor CLI
nodes.description: Rust command-line entrypoint: open/scan/read/search/lint/graph/git/publish/tui/daemon subcommands. Routes index/search/health through the daemon by default, or runs in-process with `--in-process`. Also serves as the vault context binary for the TypeScript MCP server.

nodes.name: TypeScript MCP Server (stdio)
nodes.description: MCP server implemented in TypeScript with four permission modes (off/read-only/draft/write-approved). Talks to the vault by shelling out to the `scriptor` CLI (search/read/backlinks/health-diagnostics) when no in-process context is bound; keeps an audit log and draft-patch queue.

nodes.name: Rust Daemon MCP Server (stdio)
nodes.description: `scriptor-daemon mcp-stdio --vault <path> [--trust-stdio]`: serves MCP tools over stdio JSON-RPC from the Rust kernel. 15 read tools (search, readNote, inspectBacklinks, inspectGraphSummary, traverseGraph, exportGraph, renderMarkdown, executeDql, listInbox, ...) and 3 write tools (proposePatch, createNote, updateFrontmatter) that write only with `--trust-stdio`. Reconciles pending MCP mutations on startup.

nodes.name: xtask (release/CI orchestration)
nodes.description: Cargo xtask binary used by the release gate (`cargo xtask release-smoke`) for pre-release verification. Development harness, not part of the runtime data path.

nodes.name: Headless export script (CI)
nodes.description: Node script that exports a vault headlessly in CI (`pnpm export:headless`), exercising the export pipeline without the desktop shell.

nodes.name: Frontend Workspace Orchestration
nodes.description: React hooks that own the workspace state machine: open vault (idle → opening → indexing → ready), config merge, activity log, filesystem-event hydration, session persistence, Git/export/knowledge sub-workspaces.

nodes.name: CodeMirror Markdown Editor
nodes.description: @scriptor/editor package: CodeMirror 6 editor with wikilink decorations, frontmatter gutter, task toggles, tables, snippets, typography transforms, vim mode, spellcheck/LanguageTool and round-trip validation.

nodes.name: Markdown Preview Pipeline
nodes.description: @scriptor/renderer package: renders Markdown to HTML with KaTeX, Mermaid/PlantUML diagram placeholders, citation spans, safe external URL handling and editor/preview scroll sync.

nodes.name: Knowledge Workbench
nodes.description: Panels for orphans, dead ends, unresolved link targets, tags, inbox, saved views and DQL execution over the derived index.

nodes.name: Knowledge Graph Visualization
nodes.description: Cytoscape graph canvas fed by `indexerGraph`/`indexerTraverseGraph`; d3-force layout runs in a Web Worker; panels expose focused graph, backlinks and BFS traversal results.

nodes.name: Canvas Board UI
nodes.description: @scriptor/canvas package plus CanvasPanel: CRDT-style canvas ops, template application, hit-testing and SVG rasterization off the main thread.

nodes.name: Publish Center
nodes.description: Diff-review UI around the four-bucket publish plan (new/changed/unchanged/orphaned); user approves a subset before `publish_apply` runs.

nodes.name: Git Panel
nodes.description: Status/diff/commit/pull/push UI with conflict-resolution modal and isolated-index commit previews.

nodes.name: PDF/EPUB Reader
nodes.description: Bundled viewers (`public/reader/*.html`) load vault-confined PDF/EPUB bytes returned by the native reader command; annotations persist in `.scriptor/reader/annotations.json`.

nodes.name: Export UI Package
nodes.description: @scriptor/export package: profile resolution, preflight previews, citation args, diagram export helpers and plugin-contributed profiles.

nodes.name: Citation Rendering (citeproc)
nodes.description: Frontend citation formatting: runs CSL styles (citeproc JS) in a Web Worker, formats bibliographies, and validates citations through the indexer.

nodes.name: In-App MCP Runtime
nodes.description: Embeds @scriptor/mcp runtime in the renderer: MCP panel, draft patches, audit log, tool permissions gated by vault config `mcp.mode` (`off | read-only | draft | write-approved`).

nodes.name: Portal & Quick Capture Storage
nodes.description: @scriptor/portal package: quick-capture clipboard flow, portal items, workspace bundle persistence (localStorage + vault file).

nodes.name: Plugin Manager
nodes.description: Plugin state (enabled/disabled capabilities persisted in vault), plugin registry, sandboxed contribution evaluation, marketplace and WASM plugin host.

nodes.name: Shared TypeScript Contracts
nodes.description: @scriptor/core package: hand-written and `ts-rs`-generated TypeScript contracts for IPC, canvas, export, graph, notes, plugins and vault payloads; every bridge response is runtime-validated against these before use.

nodes.name: Vault Kernel
nodes.description: Path-safety, scanning, note IO, atomic writes, optimistic-concurrency hash checks, renames with rollback, lint, crypto/encryption, config, snippets, textbundle, note history and crash-visible mutation audit (intent/outcome). Defines `RelativeVaultPath`/`VaultRoot` so nothing escapes the vault.

nodes.name: Index / Search / Graph Kernel
nodes.description: Derived cache over the vault: Markdown parsing (shared `extractor` headings), incremental indexing, SQLite persistence, FTS5 search (diacritic folding, weighted BM25), backlinks, focused graph + BFS traversal, DQL, Kanban parse/move, task extraction/sync, bibliography and citation validation, health reports.

nodes.name: Native Git Adapter
nodes.description: Noninteractive git plumbing: status, isolated temporary-index commit (user index untouched), pull/push with strategy, conflict resolution with merge3, and a serializing GitQueue.

nodes.name: Export Runner
nodes.description: Pandoc discovery (hash-verified), explicit argument mapping (no shell strings), isolated export jobs with cancel slots and progress callbacks, diagram rendering, sealed-content redaction, artifact validation and bounded export logs.

nodes.name: Publish Runner
nodes.description: Frontmatter-gated publish planning: scans eligible notes (`publish: true`), diffs against prior bucket state into new/changed/unchanged/orphaned, then applies the approved subset and writes `.publish-state.json`.

nodes.name: Canvas Scene Engine
nodes.description: Native canvas scene model with typed blocks/layers, spatial hit-testing, template application with undo checkpoints, SVG/PNG/PDF snapshots and vault-bound document store.

nodes.name: BibTeX/CSL Citation Engine
nodes.description: Standalone kernel wrapping `hayagriva` BibTeX parsing; renders inline citations and bibliographies in APA/MLA/IEEE/Chicago/Harvard styles. Currently consumed as a library module; the runtime citation-validation path lives in the indexer + frontend citeproc worker.

nodes.name: System Bridge (process broker, keychain, observability)
nodes.description: Cross-cutting native services: canonical executable resolution, optional SHA-256 pinning, sandboxed commands with network policy, process-tree kill/cancel, bounded output capture and structured receipts; OS keychain (service `scriptor`); bounded redacted JSONL tracing; platform/system info.

nodes.name: Web Clip Capture
nodes.description: fetch → sanitize → extract → Markdown pipeline for URL clipping (CLI `clip` command). Pure Rust; gated behind web-clip authorization at call sites.

nodes.name: Markdown Heading Extractor
nodes.description: Single implementation of Markdown → heading tree (pulldown-cmark), shared by the indexer and exported for CLI/canvas consumers.

nodes.name: Annotation Anchoring
nodes.description: Two-stage annotation re-anchoring (exact bytes → fuzzy quote with edit distance) for text ranges; PDF page + quote and EPUB CFI selectors are opaque locators.

nodes.name: IPC Envelope Protocol (postcard frames)
nodes.description: Length-prefixed postcard frames with magic `ARCL` and a 2 MiB bound; typed `RpcRequest`/`RpcResponse`/`RpcEvent` envelope and rate limiter. Generates TypeScript contracts via ts-rs.

nodes.name: Semantic Embeddings (incubating)
nodes.description: Note embedder with OpenAI-compatible and Ollama providers; cosine-similarity search results joined to BM25 hits by note path. Not shipped as a security/platform guarantee.

nodes.name: Tantivy FTS Index (incubating)
nodes.description: Alternative full-text index implemented with Tantivy (schema, writer, top-docs search). Incubating; the default product path uses SQLite FTS5.

nodes.name: WASM Plugin Runtime (incubating)
nodes.description: Stub/wasmtime WASM plugin executor with capability grants; compiles without the wasmtime backend for CI.

nodes.name: SQLite Derived Index
nodes.description: `.scriptor/cache/index.sqlite`, schema version 8: notes, links, FTS5 (title/headings/tags/body with diacritic folding + weighted rank), citation_refs, tasks/task_tags, annotations/srs, blocks embeddings. WAL mode, foreign keys, busy timeout, r2d2 pool (8 connections), migration train v5→v8.

nodes.name: Vault Markdown Files (source of truth)
nodes.description: The user's Markdown files on disk, plus vault assets. All access is confined through `RelativeVaultPath` resolution (no symlink/traversal escape) and writes are atomic (temp + rename + fsync).

nodes.name: .scriptor Metadata Store
nodes.description: Vault-bound metadata: config.json, audit/mcp-mutations.jsonl (hash-chained intent/outcome), patch logs, rename transaction manifests, note history revisions, activity log, stats history, workspace session, snippets, saved views, plugin state, reader annotations.

nodes.name: OS Keychain
nodes.description: Operating-system keyring (service `scriptor`): AI provider API keys, Google OAuth token bundle, daemon endpoint HMAC key, encryption key sessions.

nodes.name: Bounded JSONL Logs
nodes.description: Structured, redacted, size-rotated JSONL tracing (`~/.scriptor/logs/<component>.jsonl`, 5 MB × 5 segments) plus bounded export logs and audit tails.

nodes.name: Backup Snapshots + Manifests
nodes.description: Local fast-recovery snapshots under `.scriptor/snapshots` or external disaster-recovery backups in a vault-bound directory; every backup carries a versioned SHA-256 manifest; restore verifies path/size/hash/vault-binding before promotion and journals the restore.

nodes.name: Daemon Event Hub (bounded queue)
nodes.description: Bounded (128) nonblocking fan-out of `RpcEvent`s. Slow/disconnected subscribers are disconnected and must resubscribe; overflow increments dropped_events and forces `ResyncRequired` recovery.

nodes.name: Filesystem Watcher
nodes.description: Recursive notify watcher with 300 ms debounce producing `VaultWatchBatch::Events` or `RescanRequired` on event loss; filters `.scriptor/` and non-Markdown files.

nodes.name: Export Job Runner (worker thread)
nodes.description: Daemon-owned export thread with cancel slot, progress report (idle/running/complete/failed/cancelled) and event_index counters; exports run outside the state lock.

nodes.name: Index Rebuild Job (worker thread)
nodes.description: Daemon-owned full-rebuild thread with progress report (queued/running/…/failed) and phase snapshots; spawn-once, wait on completion, watches panics.

nodes.name: Git Serialization Queue
nodes.description: Serializes git operations per repo so concurrent status/commit/pull cannot interleave index or lock files.

nodes.name: Frontend Web Workers
nodes.description: Off-main-thread compute: citeproc CSL formatting, d3-force graph layout, canvas SVG → PNG rasterization.

nodes.name: Google Calendar / Tasks API
nodes.description: OAuth2 PKCE loopback flow into accounts.google.com; Calendar API v3 and Tasks API v1 over HTTPS; tokens refreshed transparently and persisted in the keychain.

nodes.name: OpenAI-Compatible AI Provider
nodes.description: Draft-completion endpoint for AI assistance; API key in keychain (`ai.openai-compatible.api_key`), 30 s request timeout, network access gated by `AiNetworkRequest` authorization.

nodes.name: Local Ollama (embeddings)
nodes.description: Local embedding endpoint used by the incubating embeddings crate.

nodes.name: Pandoc
nodes.description: Document conversion engine discovered on PATH (optionally pinned by SHA-256); driven with explicit args, no shell strings.

nodes.name: Tectonic (LaTeX engine)
nodes.description: Self-contained TeX/LaTeX compiler with outbound-network allowance for package downloads; 180 s timeout, bounded output.

nodes.name: PlantUML renderer
nodes.description: Local PlantUML renderer producing SVG; network denied unless explicitly opted in; optional hash pin `SCRIPTOR_PLANTUML_SHA256`.

nodes.name: PDF translation tool
nodes.description: Configured external executable that reads a vault PDF and writes translated output; gated by PdfTranslation authorization.

nodes.name: Code execution runtimes (opt-in)
nodes.description: Runtimes spawned for code chunks: powershell/pwsh, python, node, sh/bash, cmd. Denied by default; enabled by `SCRIPTOR_ALLOW_CODE_EXECUTION` (and `SCRIPTOR_ALLOW_UNSANDBOXED_CODE_EXECUTION` without sandbox). 30 s timeout.

nodes.name: Zotero Web API
nodes.description: Zotero connector package: collection/item sync against `api.zotero.org` with an API key.

nodes.name: Remote Git repository (origin)
nodes.description: Upstream/downstream git remote used by pull/push over the native git adapter.

nodes.name: Starlight site generator
nodes.description: External site generator run by the publish flow to produce a static site from the approved bucket of notes.

flows.name: Vault Open & Index (Authentication/Open Handshake)
flows.description: User opens a vault folder: renderer → native command → vault kernel validates/confines the path, recovers pending renames, then the index is rebuilt/migrated and the filesystem watcher restarts with a new generation.

steps.action: vault_open command validates path & opens vault
recover pending rename transactions; sweep stale temp files
open cache, apply schema v8 / migrate, index notes+links+FTS

flows.name: Save Note (hash-checked atomic write)
flows.description: Editor saves Markdown with optimistic concurrency: renderer → native → vault kernel checks expected content hash, appends history, atomically replaces the file, then refreshes the note index (and rolls the disk write back on index failure).

steps.action: update_note_index → incremental re-index of the path (rollback on failure)

flows.name: MCP Mutation Audit (intent/outcome hash chain)
flows.description: Write tools under the Rust daemon MCP server persist a crash-visible intent (idempotency key + hash-chain link), perform the atomic vault mutation, append the outcome; startup reconciliation resolves pending records deterministically.

steps.action: run_mcp_stdio reconciles pending mutations at startup
append intent record with idempotency_key + previous_hash
append outcome record; interrupted marker on crash

flows.name: MCP Draft Approval (TypeScript server)
flows.description: The in-app TS MCP runtime gates write tools by mode (off/read-only/draft/write-approved); drafts created, approved, then dispatched to native commands; every invocation audited.

steps.action: modeAllowsTool gate + audit append (denied on mode mismatch)
approved write dispatched to native command (save/rename/delete/frontmatter)

flows.name: Event Ingestion & Processing (filesystem watcher)
flows.description: Recursive watcher debounces changed Markdown paths into batches; daemon applies incremental index updates; on event loss a RescanRequired batch triggers full rebuild; renderer receives filesystem-changed events to hydrate.

steps.action: RescanRequired on event loss → full rebuild_index

flows.name: Search (FTS5 weighted query)
flows.description: Renderer issues indexerSearch; the indexer builds a safe FTS5 MATCH (diacritic folding, quoted prefix phrases) and returns rank-ordered hits.

flows.name: Git Commit (isolated temporary index)
flows.description: Commit selected files without touching the user's index: seed temp index from HEAD, stage literal paths, build the tree, update the branch; conflicts resolved via merge3; pull/push route to the remote.

steps.action: temporary index seeded from HEAD; stage literal requested paths
serialize through GitQueue; update branch ref, leave user index untouched

flows.name: Export Job (Pandoc orchestration)
flows.description: Export UI starts a job; desktop forwards to daemon (or runs direct); ExportJobRunner spawns a worker thread; export-runner discovers hash-verified Pandoc, writes the artifact and emits progress events to the webview.

steps.action: write artifact to default export directory

flows.name: Daemon Authentication Handshake
flows.description: Daemon generates a per-install HMAC key in the OS keychain, writes daemon-endpoint.json with nonce+HMAC; clients verify HMAC constant-time and process liveness before opening the local socket; frames are length-prefixed postcard (magic ARCL, 2 MiB bound).

steps.action: endpoint_hmac_key_runtime: get or generate keychain key
client read_endpoint verifies HMAC + pid liveness (constant-time)
connect local socket; encode/decode postcard frames (ARCL magic, 2 MiB bound)

flows.name: Cache Invalidation & Config Reload Cycle
flows.description: Config save triggers ReloadConfig RPC; daemon broadcasts ConfigReloaded (with generation) through the event hub; desktop re-emits to the webview where it is runtime-validated; slow subscribers are dropped and must ResyncRequired-reload authoritative state.

steps.action: slow subscriber disconnected → ResyncRequired on resubscribe

flows.name: Rename Note with Link Rewrite & Recovery
flows.description: Rename applies as a staged transaction (manifest + rollback), moves the file, rewrites inbound links across the vault, writes a patch log, and recovers pending transactions on next open; the daemon refreshes the note index.

steps.action: staged rename transaction manifest for crash recovery
move file + rewrite links via link_rewrite
RenameNoteApply RPC → refresh index for old/new paths

flows.name: Canvas Template Apply & Snapshot
flows.description: Canvas board applies a template: dry-run preview → apply with undo checkpoint → persist document; SVG snapshots rasterize off the main thread.

steps.action: parse scene JSON, apply template patch, store checkpoint

flows.name: Publish Plan → Approved Apply
flows.description: Publish center builds the four-bucket diff (new/changed/unchanged/orphaned) from prior bucket state; after user approval, publish_apply writes buckets, persists state, and runs the site generator.

steps.action: plan_publish scans candidates (publish: true) vs bucket state
run site generator on staged content

flows.name: Google Calendar OAuth2 PKCE & Task Sync
flows.description: PKCE loopback auth (ephemeral TCP listener + system browser), token exchange, keychain persistence; Calendar v3 / Tasks v1 calls with transparent refresh; task completion maps back to note updates.

steps.action: TcpListener loopback + browser consent; exchange code for tokens
completed task writes back to originating note (useGoogleCalendarSync)

flows.name: Kanban Card Move (source rewrite)
flows.description: Moving a card relocates the complete card line under the destination `##` heading and patches its checkbox, then saves through the canonical vault write path and refreshes the index.

steps.action: move_card_in_markdown relocates card block + checkbox status
rewrite source file through canonical save path; refresh index

flows.name: Task Extraction & Query
flows.description: Tasks are parsed from Markdown on demand (field styles), persisted into tasks/task_tags, and queried with filters.

flows.name: Reader Document Confinement & Annotations
flows.description: Reader accepts vault-relative PDF/EPUB only; native resolves and confines the path (≤128 MiB) and returns bytes; annotations are stored atomically as a JSON sidecar in the vault.

flows.name: Semantic Search (incubating)
flows.description: Optional embeddings path: index note vectors via Ollama/OpenAI-compatible provider, store in the index, overlay cosine scores on BM25 results by note path.

flows.name: Code Chunk Execution (opt-in, sandboxed)
flows.description: Code chunks run only when explicitly allowed; the process broker resolves the runner (python/node/powershell/sh/cmd), denies network unless sandbox available, bounds output/time, and kills the process tree on timeout.

steps.action: code_chunk_run builds ProcessSpec (timeout 30 s, no network)

flows.name: Backup & Restore (verified manifests)
flows.description: Local snapshots or external disaster-recovery backups carry versioned SHA-256 manifests; restore verifies path/size/hash/vault-binding before promotion, with rollback copy and restore journal.

steps.action: copy vault to snapshots or external root; write manifest
restore verifies path/size/hash + vault binding; rollback copy
